bullets.text: Velachery residents demanded a permanent, scientifically-validated flood mitigation plan rather than relying solely on emergency pumping.
Overnight rainfall averaging 7.03 cm left parts of central and south Chennai waterlogged and disrupted traffic.
Heavy rain caused road damage and a motorcycling nightmare in Velachery, where an ambulance overturned and injured its driver.
Chennai recorded an average rainfall of 70mm, leaving streets waterlogged with ankle-deep stagnant water and disrupting traffic.
Widespread rain continued across Chennai from Wednesday morning as the northeast monsoon remained active.
Persistent heavy showers prompted authorities to declare a holiday for schools in Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, and Chengalpattu on Wednesday.
A first-time offender who wore a churidar disguise to rob an elderly woman in Avadi was arrested within 24 hours.
Southern Railway announced its second AC suburban electric multiple unit service on the Central-Avadi-Arakkonam route starting October 23.
US cloud AI provider Vultr announced plans to build a 20 MW data centre in Chennai featuring an AMD AI cluster.
The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting warned private satellite TV channels to exercise caution and avoid misusing AI in news.
Tamil Nadu began IT procurement via ELCOT for the third phase of the national paperless e-Courts project.
Chief Minister Vijay launched a rainwater harvesting awareness campaign to highlight the importance of water conservation.
